reason: HTTM merges temporal visual tokens for VGGT; on 1,000 frames it reports about 7x lower latency than VGGT and 4.58x less merging cost. It is a 3D-vision transformer rather than an LLM, but temporal token merging may inform adjacent long-sequence systems.
title: HTTM: Head-wise Temporal Token Merging for Faster VGGT
